meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 你给出 diff 后,Claude 会写一行一条的审查意见:位置、问题、修复,可直接粘进 PR。默认极简;遇到安全类问题等会改用完整段落。
howto.when: 当你运行 /caveman-review,或说「review this PR」「review the diff」等时触发。它只做审查:不写修复代码、不做批准或拒绝。

say.note: 输出一行一条的审查意见

say.text: review the diff,标上严重度前缀

say.note: 恢复成啰嗦的完整审查风格

howto.what_en: After you share a diff, Claude writes one-line review comments: location, problem, fix, ready to paste into the PR. Terse by default; it switches to full paragraphs for security findings.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman-review, or when you say "review this PR" or "review the diff". Review only: it does not write the fix or approve/request changes.

say_en.text: review the diff, with severity prefixes
